scope: Proposition 8.3 of the manuscript “The Bass trace conjecture and the characteristic-zero Kaplansky idempotent conjecture” (preprints/The-Bass-trace-conjecture-for-complex-group-rings-September-24-2026/The-Bass-trace-conjecture-for-complex-group-rings-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 207 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1c4d90b5ed4de2ef), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 27. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every integer m ≥ 1, the formula ψm(y0, . . . , y2m) = 2m X i=0 (−1)i pm(h0, . . . , b hi, . . . , h2m), (8.3) where hi ∈ G is any lift of yi ∈ Y , defines an H-invariant linear functional ψm : E2m → C satisfying ψm∂ = 0, ψm(z2m) = 2−m λ. Here evaluation on the coinvariant chain z2m is defined by H-invariance.
